what_happened: Re-deriving lint-agent-contracts.sh's fragment-path variables live found six variables (one new: MODIFIED_FILES_FRAGMENT/Check L), not the four-or-five the originating plan recorded -- direct, live confirmation that a hardcoded exclusion list in the new durable record would already be stale, validating the dispatch's derivation-rule requirement with concrete evidence rather than just restating it.

Confirmed via index-entries.json inspection that the index only ever registers context/-relative paths (zero of 171 entries are docs/-prefixed); this single fact resolves the dispatch's open PLACEMENT decision in favor of a new agent-system/extensions/core/context/standards/ file over a docs/reference/standards/agent-frontmatter-standard.md section, since the latter would fail the REGISTRATION requirement outright.
